No. 1982/10– TUESDAY, AUGUST, 30, 2016
EXTRAORDINARY
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 7

My No. :KDS/PDB/4/3/10/212 Land Min’s Ref No. : 4-3/7/2014/HW/111 I hereby give notice, under sub-section (1) of section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No.28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the land described below for a public purpose. Description of the land to be acquired: Eight (08) allotments of land in total extent of about 0.0104 hectare depicted in the Preliminary Plan No. Maha 6574 dated 19.05.2016 prepared by the Surveyor General situated in the village of Madawala in the Grama Niladhari Division No. 633 of Napana and No. 637 of Madawala Madige in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Pathadumbara in Kandy District of the Central Province and bounded as follows.

1. Lot No. 01 Name of the Land:—; Description: Open Waste land, Part of a building available; Claimant: State; Original Claimant: G.W. Nishshanka, No. 28/1, Theldeniya Road, Madawala; Extent: 0.0017 hectare.

2. Lot No. 02 Name of the Land:—; Description: Open Waste land; Claimant: State; Original Claimant: A. J. M. Saleem, No. 27/D, Theldeniya Road, Madawla Bazaar; Extent: 0.0008 hectare. 3. All persons interested in the aforesaid land/ servitude on which a servitude is to be acquired are hereby required to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at the Divisional Secretariat – Pathadumbaraon 27/09/2016 at 10.00 a.m. and are hereby

requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 20/09/2016, the nature of their interests in the land/ lands, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said land/servitude, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount. All deeds and documents in support of the claims should be produced before me at the inquiry. G. H. M. A. Premasinghe Divisional Secretary Pathadumbara Divisional Secretariat, Pathadumbara. 09 - 538
